name: Fountain of the Four Rivers
note: Bernini's fountain in Piazza Navona, Rome.

name: The Little Mermaid
note: Edvard Eriksen's 1913 bronze at Langelinie, Copenhagen.

name: East Side Gallery
note: The painted stretch of the Berlin Wall; its best-known panel, Vrubel's My God, Help Me to Survive This Deadly Love, is visited with it and is not a separate entry.

name: Vigeland installation
note: Gustav Vigeland's sculpture installation in Frogner Park, Oslo, the Monolith included: one work, not a museum's collection.

name: Maman (Bilbao)
note: Louise Bourgeois's spider exists in several casts; the item is the cast beside the Guggenheim Bilbao, the one the sources name.

name: Puppy
note: Jeff Koons's flower-covered dog beside the Guggenheim Bilbao.

name: The Thinker
note: Rodin's bronze exists in many casts; the item is the one in the garden of the Musée Rodin, Paris, where the sources that place it put it.

name: Jet d'Eau
note: A permanent water jet on Lake Geneva, not a show fountain.

name: Grand Cascade of Peterhof
note: The fountain group below the Grand Palace at Peterhof, with the Samson fountain at its centre; the sources name either the cascade's fountains as a whole or Samson.

name: Friendship of Peoples Fountain
note: At VDNKh, Moscow.

name: Fountain of Warsaw (Trocadéro fountains)
note: The fountains in the Trocadéro gardens facing the Eiffel Tower, Paris.

name: Tuttomondo
note: Keith Haring's mural on the wall of Sant'Antonio Abate, Pisa.

name: Sea Organ
note: The sound installation set into the waterfront steps of Zadar.

name: Sun Voyager
note: Jón Gunnar Árnason's steel ship on the Reykjavík shore.

name: Gardens of Bomarzo (Park of the Monsters)
note: The Sacro Bosco: a sixteenth-century wood of sculptures carved in the rock, one work rather than a collection.

name: Spoonbridge and Cherry
note: In the Minneapolis Sculpture Garden.

name: LOVE (Robert Indiana)
note: The sources name different casts (Philadelphia's LOVE Park, Shinjuku) or the work in general, so the item is the work itself rather than one cast.

name: Bethesda Terrace and Fountain
note: The terrace and its fountain with the Angel of the Waters in Central Park, one place, on whose item the articles are; the fountain alone is Q124784549.

name: Alice in Wonderland (Central Park)
note: José de Creeft's bronze group in Central Park.

name: Crack Is Wack
note: Keith Haring's mural in Harlem.

name: We the Youth
note: Keith Haring's mural in Philadelphia.

name: Salvation Mountain
note: Leonard Knight's painted hillside near Niland, California.

name: Mustangs at Las Colinas
note: A bronze herd running through a fountain in Irving, Texas.

name: The Awakening
note: J. Seward Johnson's giant emerging from the ground, at National Harbor, Maryland, since 2008.

name: La Joute
note: Jean-Paul Riopelle's fountain of fire and water in Montreal.

name: Etnias
note: Eduardo Kobra's mural on the Boulevard Olímpico, Rio de Janeiro.

name: Escadaria Selarón
note: A public stairway in Rio de Janeiro that Jorge Selarón covered in tiles: the work is the tiling, which is what a traveller goes to see.

name: Merlion
note: The fountain statue in Merlion Park, Singapore.

name: Fountain of Wealth
note: At Suntec City, Singapore.

name: Pumpkin (Naoshima)
note: Yayoi Kusama's yellow pumpkin on the pier at Naoshima; the original was lost to a typhoon in 2021 and replaced.

name: King Fahd's Fountain
note: A permanent water jet in the sea off Jeddah, not a show fountain.

name: Flower Thrower
note: Banksy's mural in Beit Sahour, near Bethlehem.

name: Rock Garden of Chandigarh
note: Nek Chand's garden of sculptures from waste, one work rather than a collection.

name: Archibald Fountain
note: In Hyde Park, Sydney.

name: Wynwood Walls
note: An open-air ensemble of murals in Miami's Wynwood district, visited as one place: a wall of street art taken whole.
